summary: Tested all 4 new features: VideoModal, Spotlight, AdminPanel, GSAP ScrollTrigger. All core flows working correctly. Minor GSAP console warning noted.

issues: Backdrop close: clicking the outer wrapper element in tests hits inner content (stopPropagation). Behavior is correct UX-wise - user must click outside the modal content area to close. Not a bug.

action_items: MINOR: useScrollReveal() hook returns a containerRef but App.js doesn't attach it to any DOM element (just calls `useScrollReveal()` without assigning the ref). This causes repeated 'Invalid scope' GSAP console warnings. Fix: either attach the returned ref to the landing page div, or change gsap.context to not use containerRef (use `gsap.context(() => {...})` without the scope argument). GSAP animations still work but warnings are noisy.
critical_code_review_comments: useGsap.js: gsap.context(callback, containerRef) is called but containerRef.current is null because the returned ref is never attached to any DOM element in App.js. This produces many 'Invalid scope' console warnings. GSAP still runs the animations globally but the context scope is lost.
